name: hyperform-ui-mcp-server
description: MCP server for reading and modifying Hyperform3 page UI JSON (uiSchema/schema)

scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:frontend
scripts.gen-cert: cd certs && mkcert localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1 && move localhost+2.pem localhost.pem && move localhost+2-key.pem localhost-key.pem
